name: Silver Whetstone
lore: Sealed in silver, this old-kingdom grit lets the edge choose its own end.

name: Might Whetstone
lore: Grind on this coarse border-quarry stone and the edge comes off hungry.

name: Crit Whetstone
lore: The fine, patient stone that teaches a blade to find the seam.

name: Hit Whetstone
lore: Trues a crooked edge back to a straight, honest line.

name: Weight Whetstone
lore: Takes off the metal every smith swears he needs.
